introHtml: When you need branded seating on a tight deadline, custom rush folding chairs are the answer. Our expedited production ensures your chairs are ready for corporate events, trade shows, or outdoor gatherings without the standard lead time. Choose from heavy-duty options like the Camp Throne or lightweight models with carrying bags. Decorate with screen printing or full-color transfers for maximum visibility.
